reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents Coin Depot as an example of a crypto-yield service, explains depositing XRP and selecting an account, and directs interested viewers to a sign-up link while disclosing possible commission compensation. Its return material uses stated rates and conditional calculations rather than guaranteeing a particular viewer outcome. Financial-content, volatility, and risk disclaimers frame the discussion as promotional commentary whose accuracy or safety is not established.

opening.argument: Judge, the return claim is tied to a transfer of assets, not merely a view about XRP. The description advertises up to 23% APY through Coindepo, while the speaker tells viewers to deposit XRP, choose an interest account and start earning. He closes by directing interested viewers to the link below to sign up today. That reward-to-deposit-to-sign-up sequence is the central solicitation; presenting it as an example does not remove the requested financial action.

citations.quote: 💰Earn up to 23% APY on your crypto on Coindepo: https://cutt.ly/ltFgXOid
First, you're gonna deposit your XRP, then you're gonna to choose your account type, and then you can immediately start earning daily compound interest
If you guys are interested in using Coin Depot as well, I'll be leaving the link down below so you guys can sign up today

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense accurately notes that the example includes account selection and a disclosed commission. Those facts do not make the offer merely educational: the same walkthrough tells viewers to deposit XRP and start earning, and the closing invitation supplies the sign-up step. Calling the five-year calculation conditional addresses the projection, but not the immediate promise that depositing starts daily compound interest.

citations.quote: First, you're gonna deposit your XRP, then you're gonna to choose your account type, and then you can immediately start earning daily compound interest
If you guys are interested in using Coin Depot as well, I'll be leaving the link down below so you guys can sign up today

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cited material establishes a promoted lending offer and a participation path, but it does not establish that the platform misrepresents its returns or withholds deposits. The description expressly warns of loss of capital, irreversible transactions and potential fraud, and says no profits or outcomes are guaranteed. A sign-up link and quoted rates alone cannot establish deception.

citations.quote: Loss of capital • Extreme volatility • Limited liquidity • Irreversible transactions • Potential for fraud, theft, or manipulation
No profits or outcomes are guaranteed. You bear full responsibility for any decisions made.

opening.argument: Judge, consider the combined pitch. The speaker promises a way to grow an XRP stack every day without selling or taking extra risk, then presents a projected $465,000 outcome and says viewers could be making millions as he is. The description leads with an up-to-23% APY offer and a shortened link. The concern is not any one rate in isolation: the low-risk framing, outsized examples and direct route to a yield offer work together to make depositing crypto seem unusually easy to justify.

citations.quote: grow their XRP stack every single day without selling a single coin, without taking extra risk and without giving up their upside
You'll be now instead be getting $465,000.
situations, you could be making millions of dollars like I am now that I am leveraging this platform
💰Earn up to 23% APY on your crypto on Coindepo: https://cutt.ly/ltFgXOid

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense's conditional five-year calculation does not account for the opening's unqualified phrase 'without taking extra risk.' Nor does disclosing possible commission resolve the tension between that reassurance and the description's warning that crypto can involve loss of capital. The question is how the offer is framed to viewers before they decide whether to follow the link, not whether a disclaimer appears elsewhere.

citations.quote: without selling a single coin, without taking extra risk
Crypto-assets are speculative and involve substantial risk, including: • Loss of capital

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The opening singles out optimistic language but does not show that the displayed balance, projected calculation or offered yield is fabricated. The description explicitly warns of substantial risk and says no outcome is guaranteed. An aggressive sales pitch with a questionable risk comparison is reason for caution, but these citations do not establish a deceptive investment operation.

citations.quote: Crypto-assets are speculative and involve substantial risk
No profits or outcomes are guaranteed. You bear full responsibility for any decisions made.

opening.argument: Judge, the warning about idle XRP functions as a funnel into one named lending platform. The speaker compares holding to leaving rental property empty, introduces Coin Depot as the way he puts assets to work, invokes its claimed scale and custody credentials, and finishes with a sign-up invitation. He also says he may earn a commission through links. Read together, the educational framing and personal endorsement are part of a promotion intended to move viewers from holding XRP to placing it in an interest account; the disclaimers do not change that function.

citations.quote: Just holding XRP without putting it to work is like owning a rental property and leaving it empty with zero tenants.
2021 and manages over 230 million dollars in assets today with more than a hundred and eight thousand active users and enterprise grade custody via fireblocks soc2 type 2 certified
My choice is coin Depot because they check all of the boxes for me. If you guys are interested in using Coin Depot as well, I'll be leaving the link down below
I may earn a commission through some of the links below — at no extra cost to you.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense calls Coin Depot an example, but the speaker's endpoint is a recommendation of that specific service and an invitation to sign up. Commission disclosure identifies an incentive; it does not neutralize the endorsement. The cited conditional calculation likewise says little about whether claimed security credentials and projected returns deserve the confidence the speaker asks viewers to place in this platform.

citations.quote: My choice is coin Depot because they check all of the boxes for me. If you guys are interested in using Coin Depot as well, I'll be leaving the link down below
so on the security side they've built proper infrastructure which gives me a lot of confidence in using their platform

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The promotion is real, but identifying promotion does not establish a scam. The speaker acknowledges a possible commission, tells viewers to do due diligence and check rates, security and track record, and the description warns that profits are not guaranteed. The prosecution has not shown that the security claims are false or that the sign-up path causes a deceptive loss.

whatever platform you guys choose to do, your due diligence, always check the rates, check the security, check the track record
No profits or outcomes are guaranteed.
